<thought>Based on the observed isotopic peak series spaced ~1.003 Da apart with relative intensities matching the expected carbon 13C pattern (M+1 ≈ 8 % of M, M+2 ≈ 0.5 % of M), carbon is the only element whose isotopic distribution is definitively present. No chlorine, bromine, sulfur, nitrogen, oxygen, or other characteristic patterns are observed.</thought>
<final_answer>['C']</final_answer>
